answer: To resist Sybil attacks, require each agent identity to meet a skill-diversity quota every epoch: it must complete three unrelated kinds of verified work-data labeling, code review, and live user support-each attested by a different peer group. A script that farms one task cannot pass all three, and hiring specialists for every fake identity multiplies cost linearly while rewards stay flat. Like a gale that exposes a thin ivory facade, diversity checks reveal copies: identical solution fingerprints across identities trigger a mirror audit, collapsing the whole cluster and slashing its bonds.
